answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 100 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a vine bet on surviving 100 epochs of grading, and every river settlement recomputes the sparrow schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
